claim_text: The Honolulu Fire Department had launched dozens of weather-related responses by 2 a.m. local time on Sunday 16 August 2026, including 58 reports of downed trees, 39 blown roofs, 12 downed power lines, 12 arcing-wire situations and one swimmer rescue.
quote: The Honolulu Fire Department had launched dozens of weather-related responses by 2 a.m. local time Sunday, including 58 reports of downed trees, 39 blown roofs, 12 downed power lines, 12 arcing-wire situations and one swimmer rescue, according to a statement from the city.
confidence_justification: Itemised tally issued in a written statement from the city of Honolulu.
